bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health care; appropriating money for mobile crisis grants and protected transport start-up grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; MOBILE CRISIS GRANTS.

$....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for mobile crisis grants under Minnesota Statutes, sections 245.4661, subdivision 9, paragraph (b), clause (15), and 245.4889, subdivision 1, paragraph (b), clause (4).

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATION; PROTECTED TRANSPORT START-UP GRANTS.

$....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for start-up grants to providers of nonemergency medical transportation services and mobile crisis teams to provide protected transport, including purchasing or configuring vehicles to meet protected transport requirements.
